purpose: Enter multiline text with optional bounded automatic growth and a character count.
behaviorProvider: Native HTML textarea with React state, measured growth and shared useFieldControl metadata.

component: Native multiline editing and forwarded textarea ref
Value callbacks and optional measured growth
Associated label, descriptions and character count
host: Appropriate rows, maxRows and content limits

requirements.statement: Display value when supplied or local text initialized from defaultValue otherwise. Changes update local state only when value is undefined, then call onValueChange and onChange.
Render a native textarea with rows, maxLength and supported remaining textarea attributes, including name, form and readOnly; forward the public ref to that element.
Resolve required, disabled, invalid and ARIA references through useFieldControl. Associate the optional visible label and merge the counter id into aria-describedby when showCount is enabled.
When showCount is enabled, render text.length with the optional maxLength denominator. This count uses JavaScript UTF-16 code units, not grapheme clusters or bytes.

When autoGrow is enabled, calculate height from computed line height, padding, border and scrollHeight, bounded by rows and maxRows; switch vertical overflow to auto when content exceeds the upper bound.
Recalculate growth when text or relevant sizing props change and when ResizeObserver detects a width change; disconnect that observer on effect cleanup.
Retain native multiline keyboard editing and pass disabled/readOnly through to the textarea. The wrapper does not bind Enter to submission or provide an Escape action.

Update value in response to accepted edits when using controlled mode. Own explicit reset behavior and validation of supplied programmatic values; native maxLength is not a programmatic-value truncation service.
Provide a label, Field or explicit accessible name, including when appearance is plain inside another composition. Supply meaningful error descriptions and sensible positive rows/maxRows.
Use the input group for owned styles and fixed design defaults, retain keyboard-visible focus, and preserve size and font metrics across the four theme/mode mappings.

limitations: The existing AutoGrowAndCounter story links a typing/count assertion; it does not certify all growth, resize, Unicode or native-form cases.
The wrapper has no explicit native form-reset synchronization listener.
Character counting is not grapheme-aware. Neither a counter nor an invalid flag validates application content.
